title: Cisco Webex Webhook
description: Represents a webhook registration that receives real-time HTTP callbacks when specific events occur in Webex.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the webhook.

targetUrl.description: The URL that receives webhook POST requests.

resource.description: The resource type monitored by the webhook.

event.description: The event type monitored by the webhook.

filter.description: The filter expression for narrowing webhook scope.

secret.description: Secret used for generating payload signatures for verification.

status.description: The current status of the webhook.

orgId.description: Organization ID of the webhook owner.

createdBy.description: Person ID of the webhook creator.

appId.description: Application ID associated with the webhook.

created.description: Date and time the webhook was created.
